article.title: More than 200 days under the Energy Blockade: The silent suffocation of the Cuban people
article.author: Editor
article.content: So far in 2026, Cuba has received a single shipment of oil: some 100,000 metric tons of crude donated by Russia—and nothing else. The post More than 200 days under the Energy Blockade: The silent suffocation of the Cuban people appeared first on MR Online .
